integrity: The proof determines the exact landmarks favoring each ordered same-side pair, derives the complete complement classification, proves every allowed complement type by explicit witnesses, and then counts all sets. The verifier independently checks every subset through n=9.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected crown graphs with n at least three.
Only ordinary solid resolution is covered.
Finite verification through n=9 is corroborative only.
The foundational article has month-level February 2019 public-date evidence but no exact day was verified; the exact metadata date uses the 4 March 2020 primary preprint.
A differently named or non-indexed crown computation may exist.
title: All solid-resolving sets of crown graphs
